scope.purpose: Independent adversarial bug and sensitive-zone hunt after F1.
included: state, checkpoint, cache and determinism boundaries
input validation, element dispatch and public APIs

findings.title: The v2 maturity registry was omitted from the wheel runtime data.
findings.before: A rebuilt wheel contained legacy qualification data but not qualification/0_2_7/capability_registry_v2.json; installed preflight therefore lost the authoritative maturity source.
findings.fix: Resolve the resource through solveur.paths.project_path and install the registry under the versioned qualification/0_2_7 data-files destination.

findings.title: Dynamic and harmonic registry aliases did not resolve canonical registry rows.
findings.before: transient_dynamic/newmark and harmonic aliases could be reported as experimental or unsupported while matching qualified registry combinations used newmark_transient/harmonic.
findings.fix: Normalize registry row analyses with the same alias map used for requests, including the newmark_transient alias.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON model keys were accepted with last-write-wins semantics.
findings.before: A valid nested model with a repeated material key was accepted and the later value silently replaced the earlier value.
findings.fix: Use an object_pairs_hook that rejects duplicate keys in JsonModelReader and report a deterministic InputValidationError.

findings.title: Evidence manifests accepted duplicate keys.
findings.fix: EvidenceBundleVerifier now rejects duplicate JSON keys before schema checks.

findings.title: The result writer could emit non-standard NaN or Infinity JSON values.
findings.fix: JsonResultWriter uses allow_nan=False and raises InputValidationError without writing a non-finite result artifact.

findings.title: The new preflight geometry rejection bypassed the legacy MeshValidationError contract.
findings.before: A degenerate geometry was rejected safely, but AnalysisRouter exposed CompatibilityError instead of the established MeshValidationError and G04 expected diagnostic.
findings.fix: Geometry failures remain preflight fail-closed and are mapped to the legacy mesh validation category with the existing validator diagnostic.

findings.title: Descriptor aliases are not accepted as JSON element input aliases.
findings.decision: Descriptor aliases remain descriptive until an explicit input/API alias contract is approved; canonical dispatch remains fail-closed.
findings.owner_action: Define and test input alias semantics in a future API decision.

findings.title: Legacy generic maturity policy duplicates combination registry authority.
findings.decision: Keep the conservative legacy result and defer semantic reconciliation; no capability was promoted.

findings.title: Modal eigenpair refinement has a broad diagnostic catch.
findings.decision: Residual validation still blocks invalid corrections; narrow exception preservation is deferred to avoid an unrelated refactor.

findings.title: Repository launcher sys.path bootstrap can select another checkout in a contaminated environment.
findings.decision: Installed entry points remain usable; launcher/environment isolation needs a separate packaging decision.

findings.title: Missing or malformed registry data is conservatively downgraded to an experimental route.
findings.decision: No qualified claim is produced; turning this into an infrastructure failure requires an explicit runtime contract and is deferred.

findings.title: Root export collection ordering is not stable.
findings.decision: Names are preserved and ordering is not a documented public contract.

validation.wheel_registry_probe: PASS: installed registry exists; static and transient dynamic resolve QUALIFIED_BOUNDED

decisions.p0_p1_action: All P1 findings fixed with targeted changes.
decisions.status_basis: No P0/P1 finding remains; deferred P2/P3 limitations are explicit and no solver formulation changed.

known_limitations: Legacy model maturity and combination registry semantics remain duplicated and conservative.
Modal refinement exception provenance remains broader than desired.
Repository launcher environment isolation is not hardened in this audit.
Missing registry data remains an experimental demotion rather than a hard infrastructure failure.
No full regression or heavy benchmark was run by policy.
